title: 第3章 厨房里的炼丹师第4章 丹道之威
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
翌日清晨，当第一缕熹微的晨光，穿过破旧的窗棂，洒在林天那张略显苍白的脸上时，他缓缓地，睁开了双眼。
一夜的打坐，并未让他感到丝毫疲惫。
恰恰相反，当那缕属于丹尊凌霄的浩瀚神魂，与这具名为林天的少年之躯，初步完成融合之后，一种前所未有的、掌控一切的感觉，油然而生。
世界，仿佛被拆解成了最本源的模样。
空气中，那些肉眼不可见的、驳杂的天地灵气，在他眼中，如同五颜六色的顽皮精灵，清晰可辨。
不远处，墙角那株枯黄的杂草，其根茎的脉络，叶片的生机，甚至它因为缺水而发出的那一丝微弱的“哀鸣”
，他都能，清晰地“听”
到。
这，便是丹尊的神魂之威！
哪怕如今只恢复了万分之一，也足以，俯瞰这片凡尘俗世。
“只是”
林天缓缓抬起自己的双手，看着那双略显瘦弱、掌心甚至没有多少老茧的少年之手，眉头，微微蹙起。
“这具身体太弱了。”
他能清晰地感知到，这具身体的经脉，狭窄而脆弱，如同乡间的小路；丹田气海，更是如同干涸的池塘，只剩下那么一小洼，可怜的灵力。
更糟糕的是，三年前那场炸炉，不仅伤了他的神魂，更在这具身体里，留下了无数难以察觉的暗伤。
“根基不稳，丹炉破损，强行修炼，无异于自取灭亡。”
他心中自语，“当务之急，并非是提升修为，而是重铸丹炉！”
“少爷，您…您醒了？”
一个怯生生的声音，打断了林天的思绪。
侍女小雨，端着一碗清可见底、只有几粒米花的稀粥，小心翼翼地走了进来。

不知为何，她总感觉，自家少爷自昨日从演武场回来之后，整个人，都变得不一样了。
依旧是那张清秀的脸，但那双眼睛，却深邃得，如同夜空中的星辰，让她不敢直视。
林天接过粥碗，看着小雨那张因长期营养不良而显得有些蜡黄的小脸，心中那属于少年林天的柔软，被轻轻触动了。
小雨，是这三年来，唯一一个，还留在他身边，对他不离不弃的人。
“辛苦你了。”
林天温和地说道。
这简简单单的四个字，却让小雨的眼圈，瞬间就红了。
她连忙低下头，不敢让少爷看到自己的失态。
林天将那碗几乎能照出人影的米粥，一饮而尽。
一股微弱的暖流，滑入腹中。
“聊胜于无。”
他摇了摇头，随即，对小雨吩咐道，“小雨，去厨房，帮我找一口家里最大的铁锅来。
另外，再去米仓，领一些最普通的‘火灵米’和清水。”
“啊？少爷，您要亲自下厨？”
小雨一脸的错愕。
在她印象中，自家少爷虽然落魄了，但十指不沾阳春水的习惯，还是没变的。
林天神秘一笑，眼中，闪过一丝，只有他自己才懂的，丹尊的“骄傲”
“算是吧。”
“今天，就让你见识一下，什么才叫做真正的‘食补丹道’。”
……

很快，在那破旧的小院里，一口足有半人高、锅底还带着几个补丁的大铁锅，便被支了起来。
林天没有急着生火。
他先是，将那些晶莹剔透、蕴含着一丝微弱火系灵力的“火灵米”
，倒入锅中，不多不少，正好铺满了锅底薄薄的一层。
content_en:
The next morning, when the first ray of morning light passed through the dilapidated window lattice and fell on Lin Tian's slightly pale face, he slowly opened his eyes.
A night of meditation did not make him feel tired at all.
On the contrary, when the vast soul belonging to Alchemy Lord Lingxiao and the body of the young man named Lin Tian were initially integrated, an unprecedented feeling of being in control of everything arose spontaneously.
The world seems to have been dismantled into its most original form.
In the air, the invisible and mixed auras of heaven and earth were clearly distinguishable in his eyes like colorful naughty elves.
Not far away, the withered yellow weed in the corner, the veins of its rhizome, the vitality of its leaves, and even the faint "whining" it emits due to lack of water.
, he can "hear" clearly
Arrive.
This is the power of Alchemy Lord’s soul!
Even if only one ten thousandth of it has been restored now, it is still enough to overlook this mortal world.
"just"
Lin Tian slowly raised his hands, looked at the slightly thin young hands with not many calluses on the palms, and frowned slightly.
"This body is too weak."
He could clearly feel that the meridians of this body were narrow and fragile, like a country road; the Dantian Qi sea was like a dried up pond, with only a small pool left, and poor spiritual power.
What's worse is that the furnace explosion three years ago not only damaged his soul, but also left countless hidden wounds that are difficult to detect in this body.
"The foundation is unstable, the alchemy furnace is damaged, and forcing cultivation is tantamount to self-destruction."
He thought to himself, "The top priority is not to improve your cultivation, but to rebuild the alchemy furnace!"
"Master, are you...are you awake?"
A timid voice interrupted Lin Tian's thoughts.
The maid Xiao Yu walked in cautiously, carrying a bowl of gruel with only a few grains of rice pops visible on the bottom.
For some reason, she always felt that her young master had become completely different since he came back from the martial arts arena yesterday.
She still had that delicate face, but her eyes were as deep as the stars in the night sky, making her dare not look directly into them.
Lin Tian took the porridge bowl and looked at Xiao Yu's little face that looked sallow due to long-term malnutrition. The softness that belonged to the young Lin Tian in his heart was gently touched.
Xiao Yu is the only person who has stayed with him in the past three years and never left him.
"Thank you for your hard work."
Lin Tian said gently.
These four simple words made Xiaoyu's eyes turn red instantly.
She quickly lowered her head, not daring to let the young master see her gaffe.
Lin Tian drank the bowl of rice porridge that could almost reflect the figure of a person in one gulp.
A weak warm current slid into his belly.
"Better than nothing."
He shook his head, and then ordered Xiao Yu, "Xiao Yu, go to the kitchen and help me find the largest iron pot in the house.
In addition, go to the rice warehouse and get some of the most common 'Fire Spirit Rice' and clear water. "
"Ah? Master, do you want to cook in person?"
Xiaoyu looked stunned.
In her impression, although her young master has fallen into despair, his habit of not touching the spring water has not changed.
Lin Tian smiled mysteriously, and there was a flash in his eyes that only he could understand, Alchemy Zun's "pride"
"So be it."
"Today, I'm going to let you see what the real 'food tonic pill way' is."
…
Soon, in the dilapidated courtyard, a large iron pot that was half a person's height with a few patches on the bottom was propped up.
Lin Tian was not in a hurry to light a fire.
He first took those crystal clear "Fire Spirit Rice" which contained a faint trace of fire spiritual power.
, pour it into the pot, no more, no less, just covering the bottom of the pot with a thin layer.
